Class DashboardController

java.lang.Object
library.controllers.common.CommonDashboardController
library.controllers.author.DashboardController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable, RequiresLoggedIn
public final class DashboardController extends CommonDashboardController
The DashboardController class manages the loading and interaction of different dashboard components such as "My Books", "Status View", and "Information Board". It extends CommonDashboardController, inheriting its functionality. This class acts as a controller in an MVC architecture, coordinating between user interface elements and their respective data controllers.

This controller interacts with the following: - MyBooksController for managing books. - StatusViewController for displaying the current status views. - InformBoardController for managing the informational board.

The main responsibilities of this class include: - Controlling the lifecycle and data loading of dashboard components. - Ensuring specific components load their data when appropriate. - Managing user interaction for each component.

  • Method Details

    • loadMyBooks

      public void loadMyBooks()
      Loads the user's books into the "My Books" view of the dashboard.

      This method triggers the `loadData` method of `MyBooksController`, which is responsible for retrieving and displaying the active books associated with the currently logged-in author.

      The data is fetched from the repository and filtered based on the active status and the author's information, ensuring only relevant books are displayed. Once retrieved, the data is set into the table controller for visualization in the user interface.

      This method is intended to be called when the "My Books" component of the dashboard needs to be populated or refreshed.

    • loadStatusView

      public void loadStatusView()
      Loads the data for the "Status View" tab when it is selected. This method ensures that the status view's data is refreshed and properly displayed by invoking the loadData() method of the StatusViewController.

      It first checks if the "Status View" tab is currently selected using the statusViewTab.isSelected() condition. If true, it calls the loadData() method of the associated StatusViewController.

    • loadInformBoard

      public void loadInformBoard()
      Loads the data for the "Inform Board" section of the dashboard.

      This method triggers the `loadData` method of the `InformBoardController`, which is responsible for fetching and setting up the notifications to be displayed in the inform board.

      The `InformBoardController` retrieves notifications pertaining to the currently logged-in user from the repository, ensuring the displayed content is user-specific and up-to-date. Once the data is fetched, it is set into a list for visualization in the user interface.

      This method is intended to be called when the "Inform Board" component of the dashboard needs to be populated or refreshed.
